title: Minecrafts Inter-Continental Ballistic Anvil Cannon
description:
Previously I introduced the Smart Artillery which combined cheap and simply redstone components with advanced theory and fire control to make a cannon that is simple to build and easy to aim. In this video we expand on the cannon design, producing a new propulsion method that works with Anvils to deliver strikes on positions at incredible ranges. We also get to look at a new TnT cannon which uses devastating cluster charges to obliterate positions.
